comment: Single source for lower-thirds, controls card, end card and the Discord post. 'input' tokens: A B X Y Z L R C C:up|down|fwd|back stick:up|down|fwd|back dpad:down + > and keyword chips. Verify every input against the clip script's motion trace before shipping.

shots.title: Kamehameha
shots.note: Press B to start the charge, B again fires at once

shots.title: Kamehameha: charged
shots.note: Let the charge build, then B fires the level you reached

shots.title: Super Kamehameha
shots.note: Needs a full ki bar and the full 10 second charge

shots.title: Flight (full ki)
shots.note: Full ki gives a long powered flight: steer anywhere, finish with a flight aerial

shots.title: Reverse ledge grab
shots.note: Fly past the ledge, turn, grab it

shots.title: Instant Transmission roll
shots.note: Shield + left or right: he vanishes and reappears

shots.title: Dragon Rush
shots.note: Side B: on hit it flows into the full Rush Combo

shots.title: Light string to heavy finisher
shots.note: Each hit must connect to chain

shots.title: Launcher to air string
shots.note: Up heavy launches, jump after it, three neutral airs, down heavy spikes

shots.title: Forward air spike
shots.note: In the air

shots.title: Charged forward smash
shots.note: A KO move

shots.title: Ki charge
shots.note: Down B fills the ki bar; do it in the air to float down while charging

shots.title: Air ki charge
shots.note: In the air Goku floats down while charging

shots.title: Homing dash kick
shots.note: Shield, then B with the stick neutral (costs 20 ki)

shots.title: Ki blast barrage
shots.note: Hold D-pad down: a barrage that alternates hands, 5 ki a shot

shots.title: Grab and throws
shots.note: Captain Falcon style grab and throws

shots.title: Back throw
shots.note: Grab, then throw behind you

shots.title: Ledge getup
shots.note: Toward the stage from the ledge

shots.title: Ledge attack
shots.note: From the ledge

shots.title: Ledge roll
shots.note: Shield from the ledge

shots.title: Ledge jump
shots.note: Jump from the ledge

controls.name: Light string
controls.text: Five hits chain on hit. Every hit builds ki.

controls.name: Heavy
controls.text: C-stick (or an A smash flick) off any light hit: finisher, launcher or down smash.

controls.name: Kamehameha
controls.text: B starts the charge, B again fires the level reached. Shield stores it. Full ki and the full 10 second charge makes it Super.

controls.name: Dragon Rush
controls.text: Side B dash. Connects into the Rush Combo. Also a recovery.

controls.name: Flight
controls.text: Up B. Steer, then A or C-stick for a flight aerial.

controls.name: Ki charge
controls.text: Down B fills the ki bar. Works in the air too.

controls.name: Ki blast
controls.text: D-pad down, ground or air, 5 ki. Hold it for a barrage that alternates hands.

controls.name: Dash kick
controls.text: Shield then B with the stick neutral. Homing kick, costs 20 ki.

controls.name: Transmission
controls.text: Shield + left or right is an Instant Transmission roll.

controls.name: Launcher air
controls.text: Launch, jump, three neutral airs, then fair, uair or dair.

controls.name: Grab
controls.text: Captain Falcon style grab and throws.

controls.name: Ki meter
controls.text: The yellow ki bar. Hits and charging fill it, specials spend it.

install: Unzip the Goku alpha into your GD's Melee folder
Over a 0.3.0-rc5 install, say yes to replace. It adds mods/goku-xv2 and updates melee-pc.exe.
Open GD Melee and make sure Goku is enabled in Mods
The package turns him on in mods/enabled.txt.
Pick Goku on the character select
Play offline, in the LAB, or against a friend on the same alpha build.
report: This is an alpha: hitboxes are still hand-authored, balance is unfinished and some animations are rough. Tell us what breaks in the bugs channel, with what you pressed and the stage.
